test.create(first_source)
test.create(first_source::/extra)
test.create(second_source)
test.create(second_source::/extra)
test.move(first_source, /worker::first)
test.move(second_source, /worker::second)
test.create(/worker::run)
worker.create(holder)
worker.move(first, holder::/left)
worker.move(second, holder::/right)
first_destructor.create(work)
first_destructor.destroy(work)
second_destructor.create(work)
second_destructor.destroy(work)
worker.destroy(holder::/left::/extra)
worker.destroy(holder::/right::/extra)
worker.destroy(holder::/left)
worker.destroy(holder::/right)
worker.destroy(holder)
test.destroy(/worker::run)
